verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only indirect ways to keep notes with project work. Users can capture details from emails and Slack into the Trello Inbox, hold real discussions on the back of a card, use AI to write or edit content, and pull third-party data into card attachments. Nothing shows a dedicated shared docs or notes capability. Missing for 10: a native document/wiki or notes feature, ways to organize docs as their own objects, real-time co-editing of shared docs, and independent corroboration of docs-style collaboration.
